gallery.description: Map of annual tree-cover loss year in the Global Forest Change dataset for Lomami. Pixels with tree cover of at least 30% in 2000 and no mapped loss through 2024 are shown in green; pixels with mapped tree-cover loss are coloured by the first detected loss year from 2001 to 2024; land below the 30% tree-cover threshold in 2000 is shown in white; water/ocean areas are shown in pale blue.
categories: Biogeographical maps of the Democratic Republic of the Congo
